findings.summary: F0 — the spec's declared single irreplaceable acceptance criterion (§2: actually run at least one tick end-to-end via the real bin/deep-research-loop.sh and assert ticksByLabel.tick >= 1, explicitly '不得用打桩替代') — was not executed. The dev-note defers it to the gate ('故 F0 在 gate 侧执行') and its 'F0 消息数增量约束' section only restates the constraint, recording no pre/post message-count numbers, although §2.1 requires the delta be measured and written into dev-notes. The justification offered (§5 no-network) does not apply: §2.1 explicitly authorizes the real-machine run on research:p02-smoke-1dce60 under the --max-writes budget, and §5 provisions a usable loop-engine build for it. Shipping this package without F0 reproduces exactly the failure mode §0 was written to end (21 packages, 254 green cases, pipeline never ran itself once).

The tick node cannot execute its entry in a real run, so the delivered self-sustaining trigger (§1.3) cannot fire. The production value is TICK_ENTRY=`bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/bin/tick-entry.sh"` (bin/deep-research-loop.sh:25); it flows verbatim through render-template.mjs (literal ${VAR} replacement) into the fleet plain scalar and then through loop-engine's {{tick_entry}} substitution, so the rendered assignment `tick_entry="bash "/…/bin/tick-entry.sh""` yields the single string `bash /…/bin/tick-entry.sh`. tick.md then invokes it as one quoted word, `"$tick_entry" --run …` (and `"$tick_entry" --selfcheck`), which cannot resolve to an executable. With the tick node failing there is no JSON on stdout, hence no hasPendingWork, hence no continuation put — the core A9 deliverable is inert in production. This is precisely the defect class F0 exists to detect.

The F9/F10 evidence is not discriminative for the production wiring: makeFakeTick writes tick_entry as a bare executable path, a shape that never occurs in the assembled system (the assembled value carries an embedded `bash ` prefix and a space). The tests therefore pass while the real invocation shape is broken, which is the 'a unit-layer invariant holding does not mean it holds at another layer' discipline the spec calls out in §3.2.

The continuation put is guarded by a bare emptiness check on trigger_store_dir / loop_store_cli / loop_engine_runner: when any is empty the tick silently performs no put and exits 0, so a broken injection layer degrades into an indistinguishable 'board is drained' outcome. Spec §3.2 forbids silent zero-result as a completion signal; the driver fails loudly for these values but the tick node does not.

hasPendingWork is computed from `state`, the pre-write board snapshot read at the start of runChannelWrite, not from the post-write board. A tick that drives the last non-terminal clue to a terminal status still reports true and therefore enqueues one extra trigger, which the following tick resolves to false. Convergence still holds, but the field describes the board as it was before this tick's writes rather than after them.
